policy.purpose: Keep the eight named Mahadvadashi categories distinct while source review and tests are developed.
policy.notFor: Do not select fasting dates, calculate parana, or infer a category from tithi/nakshatra names alone.

policy.unresolvedHandling: If any required source-defined condition or astronomical interval is missing, return unresolved; do not choose a default.

types.sourceDefinition: सूर्योदये एकादशी ततः क्षयगामिनी द्वादशी द्वितीयसूर्योदये त्रयोदशी एवमहोरात्रे तिथित्रयस्पर्शात्

sharedSourceNote: The source states that these are observed by those seeking sin-destruction/liberation and adds that Shravana-yukta Dvadashi is nitya like Ekadashi. Do not infer from this note alone a complete fasting-date or parana algorithm.
